data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root khawwala, which means 'to be bright'. In Islamic tradition, Khuwailah represents the radiant and resplendent full moon, symbolizing guidance and wisdom. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for her piety and generosity. The name Khuwailah carries the meaning “Glowing Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuwailah usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Khuwailah, derived from the Arabic root meaning 'to be bright', honors this celestial body and its role in our lives.
